title: frametrail:attributes of type "hotspot"
description: Hotspot overlay: a clickable shape (circle, rectangle, rounded rectangle) or a drawn line (arrow, underline, freeform outline). Overlay only. This schema describes the frametrail:attributes of items whose type is "hotspot". On overlays, opacity, hoverStyle, zIndex and animation apply as on every overlay type. Unknown keys are allowed; writers keep them.

color.description: CSS colour of the outline or line.

borderWidth.description: Outline or line width in percent of the smaller side of the box.

borderRadius.description: rounded only: corner radius in pixels.

backgroundColor.description: CSS fill colour. Set, it hides the pulse ring so the hotspot reads as a button. Empty means no fill.

text.description: Label inside the hotspot, plain text.

direction.description: arrow only: where the arrow points.

curve.description: arrow only: straight, curved (one bend) or swoop (S-like).

points.description: freeform only: the outline as points in 0–100 box coordinates. Smooth points let the outline curve through them, the others are corners.

x.description: Horizontal position in percent of the box.

y.description: Vertical position in percent of the box.

smooth.description: Curve through this point instead of a corner.

path.description: freeform only: the outline as an SVG path in 0–100 box coordinates. Derived from points and written for other consumers; a shape that has only a path (older data) is drawn from it and converted to points on its first edit.

linkUrl.description: Legacy. URL opened on click, from before the action model. Treated as action "openUrl" when action is empty.
